# SmartExn - Global Online Micro-Tasks, Paid Surveys & Crowdsourced Workforce Platform

> SmartExn is a global digital micro-task, opinion survey, and crowdsourcing platform connecting task earners with verified campaign creators and advertisers.

## Overview
- **Name**: SmartExn
- **Website**: https://smartexn.com/
- **Industry**: Micro-task marketplace, crowdsourcing, survey research, digital marketing & user engagement.
- **Audience**: Global workers (earners) looking for task-based rewards; businesses & advertisers needing crowdsourced task fulfillment.

## Core Capabilities & Services

### For Workers (Earners)
- **Micro-Tasks**: Social media engagement, website testing, app installation & reviews, data verification, research tasks.
- **Paid Surveys**: Consumer opinion questionnaires, brand studies, qualification-gated market research.
- **Escrow Guarantee**: Funds are locked in escrow upon campaign creation, ensuring guaranteed payment for verified task submissions.
- **Dispute Resolution**: Two-tier dispute arbitration mechanism for proof validation fairness.
- **Payout Gateways**: Multi-gateway support including EasyPaisa, JazzCash, USDT TRC-20, Visa/MasterCard, PayPal, and Bank Transfer.

### For Advertisers (Campaign Creators)
- **Targeted Campaigns**: Custom step-by-step instructions, device targeting, geolocation rules, and proof verification questions.
- **Escrow Budgeting**: 100% money-back refund on unspent escrow budget when stopping or canceling campaigns.
- **Proof Auditing**: Real-time review and validation of submitted screenshots, usernames, and proof IDs.

## Platform Policies & Safety
- **Trust & Safety**: Zero tolerance for fraud, multi-accounting, and botting. Verified human worker validation.
- **Privacy Policy**: Adheres to strict data protection standards and user confidentiality.
- **Terms of Use**: Clear community guidelines protecting both advertisers and task workers.
